actual.target: One actual recent heard phrase; one perceived sound origin within 10 ft.
actual.duration: One playback lasting no more than 6 seconds; no stored effect.
actual.resolution: Automatic sound reproduction; observers retain actual hearing/knowledge and LR-G07 examination.
actual.procedure: Adopt the supplied Silent Echo proposal as NEW authoring direction. At declaration select the most recent complete phrase heard by the caster from an origin within 10 ft in the previous minute, before this cast’s own V. Maximum playback length is six seconds. For a longer actual utterance, select its last complete word or contiguous bounded phrase segment that was genuinely heard and fits six seconds; do not reconstruct an unheard ending. If two phrases truly finish simultaneously, choose one actual qualifying phrase. Replay its heard phonemes, cadence and vocal quality once at ordinary conversational loudness from the selected legal point. Incomplete/inaudible parts are not reconstructed.
actual.limitsAndLifecycle: No language knowledge is required to reproduce the sounds and none is gained. Another playback can be the actual heard sample, never authentication or a fidelity upgrade. Acoustics, silence, walls and perception remain real. Recasting needs a currently qualifying sample and a new paid cast/cadence event. This is not the speaker, an interpreter, V, a credential or a documented control channel.

actual.target: Fixed center within 20 ft and line of effect; 20-ft-radius sphere.
actual.resolution: Automatic acoustic field; no creature save.
actual.procedure: Adopt the supplied Silence proposal. No sound originates, propagates or is heard within the sphere or crosses its boundary while active. A sound path between two outside listeners also fails when it must traverse the field. Speech-dependent V, audible commands, musical/hearing prerequisites and sound triggers fail according to their actual location/path. Visible signs and valid purely mental techniques remain possible.
actual.limitsAndLifecycle: This is an area acoustic rule, not a permanent Deafened/Silenced record on occupants, thunder immunity, vacuum, lost breathing or suppression of physical impact. A caster outside any blocking field can complete its V before its own new sphere appears and maintain concentration inside afterward; existing silence already covering that V prevents beginning the cast. Overlapping spheres have independent expiries.

actual.paragraph: REVELATIONS are divine class techniques, not ordinary spells. Unless a Revelation explicitly says otherwise, magical silence does not prevent a purely mental Revelation, but a Revelation requiring speech, touch, visible symbolism or another listed component obeys that requirement. Revelations do not generate Dissonance and cannot be modified by spell-slot, RP, spell-rank discount or ordinary spell-proc mechanics.

engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Wisdom is the Cleric class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Cleric levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Wisdom modifier) unless a feature explicitly substitutes another ability. Cleric technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Cleric technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier.

Conviction is separate from Resonance Points. Base Conviction maximum is 3, automatically becoming 5 at Cleric 9; after a long rest you begin at your current maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent Conviction, to the maximum. A completed long rest restores all Conviction. Conviction Pool raises the maximum by 2. Conviction persists between encounters; simply declaring prayer, repeating a Rite, or performing harmless actions outside a real encounter never generates Conviction.

Only explicit features generate Conviction. Sacred Chant, Sermon of Purpose, Doctrine Shield, Dark Conviction and other printed cards are valid generators. A feature cannot generate more Conviction than its text permits, and Conviction can never exceed the current maximum. Summoned creatures, friendly creatures, trivial creatures, repeated corpse manipulation and staged out-of-combat actions cannot be used to farm Conviction.

Cleric techniques use only their printed RP and Conviction costs. All RP is paid from the Cleric's Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. A Cleric technique is not automatically an ordinary spell-rank cast and does not receive Overcast, spell-slot, cost-discount or spell-proc benefits unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. Ordinary spells continue to use Core V 2 spellcasting rules.

Protected Dissonance interaction: once on each of your regular turns, when you spend at least 2 Conviction on a Rite or Invocation, reduce Dissonance by 1, minimum 0. The expenditure must actually occur; waived Conviction costs do not vent Dissonance. A single feature expenditure vents at most once even if it spends more than 2 Conviction. No Cleric card automatically adds Dissonance unless explicitly written.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect immediately ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; for this pilot, if a division requires rounding, half damage is rounded down. Sustained Cleric effects use their printed maintenance cost and Bonus Action. A control effect that persists for multiple pulses or rounds gives the target a new save at each printed pulse or at the end of each affected turn as stated.

Round recharge counters are set after resolution and decrease once at the start of the Cleric's regular initiative turn, even if the Cleric cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not create extra recharge ticks. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one recharge tick. Only a positive counter may be reset or shortened, and a named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

Invocation Attunement is gained automatically at Cleric level 2. Choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. Only the selected path bonus becomes active. Divine Invocation uses the mode belonging to that selected path unless another feature explicitly permits a different mode. Changing Invocation Path requires a future explicit retraining rule; this draft provides none.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION FOR PLAYTEST. Cleric 1: gain the Divine Favor engine and choose 4 Base cards, at least 2 Active. Cleric 2: automatically gain Invocation Attunement and the selected Invocation Path bonus, then choose 2 additional Base cards. Cleric 3: enter Bishop and choose 2 Arch cards, at least 1 Active. Levels 4-8 each grant one eligible Base/Arch choice, respecting each card's minimum class level. Level 9 grants one eligible Arch choice plus Bishop's Mandate automatically. Level 10 choose Saint, Priest or Cultist and gain 2 Hero choices from that path. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one additional Hero choice; levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 grant one eligible unselected Base/Arch choice. The chosen Hero Finale is automatic at Cleric 20. ASI/feat milestones remain separate and do not consume these choices.

All acquisition gates use Cleric class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus still follows normal total-character-level rules. card.name: Echo Fusion
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 profile targets within 30 ft
card.effect: Choose two stored profiles. Resolve one at full dice and the other at half dice to one target each. Only one may be healing; at most one Hindrance rider. Counts as one combined release and cannot receive Dual Echo Cast simultaneously.

source.originalText: Echo Fusion: Temporarily combine two stored Echoes to create a hybrid ability with properties of both.

engine: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

Standard acquisition applies; baseline Mirrorbind, Echo Release and summon procedure become usable by selecting their cards. card.name: Echo Fusion
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 profile targets within 30 ft
card.effect: Choose two stored profiles. Resolve one at full dice and the other at half dice to one target each. Only one may be healing; at most one Hindrance rider. Counts as one combined release and cannot receive Dual Echo Cast simultaneously.

source.originalText: Echo Fusion: Temporarily combine two stored Echoes to create a hybrid ability with properties of both.

engine: Intelligence is the class ability; use d8 Hit Die from the detailed book, recording the older runtime d6 as superseded for this draft. You begin with 3 empty Echo Slots. Expansion II raises ordinary capacity 5; Sacred/Floating memory features may add one restricted slot, but total concurrent stored Echoes never exceeds 6. Slots are storage, not spell slots. Releasing normally empties that record. Rest restores RP, not spent Echoes. Starting a new encounter does not duplicate the archive.

Mirrorbind is an Action, once per encounter, against a creature within 60 ft whose eligible ability you saw resolve since the start of your previous turn. Target must have INT 6 or lower, not be a boss or possess unique/legendary status unless an encounter script explicitly permits copying. It makes WIS save versus class DC; failure captures one witnessed ability into an empty slot. No copying from allies, your companions, another copy, a corpse, a recharge-limited legendary power or an at-will source that itself restores resources. You can voluntarily erase a slot without an action on your turn, permanently losing its record.

Record source creature/name, witnessed ability, category, damage type, allowed rank, capture encounter and whether first release has occurred. For this pilot, capture copies the observed role into ONE bounded profile: Strike=one target 60 ft class spell attack S d8 observed damage type; Burst=up to 3 enemies in 10 ft radius within 30 ft DEX save S d6, half on success; Mend=one living ally 30 ft S d6+M HP; Ward=one ally 30 ft S d6+M temporary HP for 1 minute; Hindrance=one enemy 30 ft WIS save or Speed-10 ft and no Reactions until end its next turn. Choose only a profile actually expressed by the observed source; physical attack cannot become healing. Rank is max(1, ceil(source challenge rating/2)); if source lacks a rating the Director assigns a rank before the encounter, not after seeing a desirable ability. Rank cannot exceed your Mirrorsage learnable rank; no copying character levels from a creature. Damage/targets/control are capped by these profiles, not source boss dice.

Echo Release costs the Core V 2 RP cost of the recorded rank, minimum 2, consumes its record and counts as a spell for Dissonance and Refrain. Spell attack/DC use your own stats. First release of a newly captured record ignores Refrain addition only; base strain remains. Any preserved subsequent release uses ordinary repeated-spell strain. All released Echoes, pet replays, fusions and reflections share ONE release action per round; a specifically combined package counts once but pays for every component and has its printed damage cap. Copies cannot create resources or recursive Echoes.

One Mirror Beast OR Reflective Companion, never both. Mirror Beast uses standard companion stats, initially copies appearance only, and costs a Bonus Action to command. You may command it to make its normal attack OR originate your round's Echo Release from its position, paying RP and consuming the record normally; not both. You still supply an Action for release unless a feature specifically changes that action cost. A shifted appearance grants no extra actions/stats. Destroying/dismissing it grants no capture, corpse, XP or recovery. Charm Bind is 1/long rest, 3 rounds, concentration, INT 6-or-lower target WIS save and repeat at each turn end/when harmed by your side; never a player character or boss without explicit encounter permission. A charmed companion uses its own ordinary attack with damage capped at standard companion S d6; unique spells/powers remain unavailable.

Focus Point is a separate resource: when Mimicry Focus is known, receive 1 at encounter start, maximum 1, lost at encounter end. It can modify one Echo without generating another release, recapture or resource refund. No stacking damage doublings; use the printed modest die/range boost. Healing/support copies always consume RP and cannot restore RP or duplicate limited-use features.

Enhanced Song of Mending: duration 3 turns

engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Charisma is the Oracle class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Oracle levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Charisma modifier). Revelation attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. Revelation save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier.

HIT DIE CONFLICT. The class overview registry lists d8, while the detailed Player Rulebook Oracle entry states 6 + Constitution modifier at level 1 and d6 per Oracle level thereafter. This pilot uses the detailed rulebook d6 chassis: 6 + Constitution modifier at Oracle 1 and 1d6 per later Oracle level. The d8 registry value remains a preserved alternative pending owner adjudication.

The Oracle is an exceptional progression class rather than a 25-choice Base/Arch/Hero class. Base Oracle is levels 1-2, Revelation Tier development is the Arch-stage progression at levels 3-9, and Revelation Mastery is the Hero-stage progression at levels 10-20. Mystery and Curse are chosen at level 1 but their later Revelations, Boons and Final abilities remain class-level gated.

Choose exactly ONE Mystery and exactly ONE Curse at Oracle level 1. They are not parallel subclasses that stack. You never gain another Mystery or Curse unless a future explicit retraining or transformation rule says otherwise. Curse limitations are permanent and cannot be removed by ordinary cleansing, curse removal, resurrection or rest.

REVELATION CHARGES are the Oracle's only class power resource. Oracles do not use Resonance Points, spell slots, Weave Dissonance, Overcast or ordinary spell-rank casting for Revelations. Revelation Charges are abbreviated RC. A Revelation card's printed RC cost is paid once before resolution. An illegal activation spends nothing.

RC CAP SCHEDULE for this provisional module: maximum 3 at Oracle levels 1-2, 4 at levels 3-5, 5 at levels 6-8, 6 at levels 9-10 and 7 at level 11+. Increasing the maximum does not automatically refill spent charges except where another feature explicitly says so.

RC RECOVERY. A completed long rest restores RC to maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent RC, never above maximum. Each Mystery has exactly one Prophecy Trigger. During a real encounter, your Prophecy Trigger can restore at most 1 RC per round and never above maximum. Trivial enemies, willing staged targets, summoned sacrifices, repeated corpse abuse, copied damage, copied healing and events generated solely to trigger recovery do not qualify.

A single event can satisfy only one Prophecy Trigger recovery for you even if several descriptions could apply. A Revelation repeated or copied by another feature does not independently trigger Prophecy recovery unless that feature explicitly says it counts as a new Revelation use. Restored charges never recursively trigger another recovery.

At Oracle level 11, the preserved registry draft additionally sets your starting RC when a real encounter begins to at least max(3, your Charisma modifier), capped by your current RC maximum. If you already have more RC, keep the higher current value. This encounter-start floor occurs once per encounter and cannot be triggered by staged initiative.

REVELATIONS are divine class techniques, not ordinary spells. Unless a Revelation explicitly says otherwise, magical silence does not prevent a purely mental Revelation, but a Revelation requiring speech, touch, visible symbolism or another listed component obeys that requirement. Revelations do not generate Dissonance and cannot be modified by spell-slot, RP, spell-rank discount or ordinary spell-proc mechanics.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time unless a specific Oracle feature explicitly creates a narrow exception. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration procedure; if half-damage rounding is required in this pilot, round down. Sustained Revelation control effects grant repeat saves at the cadence printed on the Revelation.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Oracle-caused full-turn denial such as Stunned, Paralyzed, Incapacitated by control, or loss of its full Action from your Oracle features per encounter. After that succeeds once, later Oracle effects from you that would fully deny its turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. An additional Action cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Features that say a creature acts out of turn use this same cap. Movement-only grants do not count as additional full Actions.

Healing from Oracle features cannot exceed maximum HP, resurrect the dead or remove Wounds unless a feature explicitly says so. Temporary HP never stack. Encounter-only regeneration and drain cannot be farmed outside meaningful combat. Corpse effects create no XP, loot, RC or repeatable corpse resources unless expressly stated.

Copied, echoed, repeated or redirected damage/healing uses only the explicitly copied numeric component. It cannot repeat RC recovery, Prophecy Triggers, action grants, conditions, passive triggers, resource restoration or another copy effect unless the copying feature explicitly says otherwise.

BASE PROGRESSION. At Oracle 1 choose Mystery and Curse; gain the RC engine, Channel Revelation, Prophetic Insight and Divine Sense. At Oracle 2 gain Curse Manifestation, Oracular Trance and Oracle's Burden. No Base feature-selection currency or Skill Points are used.

ARCH-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 3: choose one Tier I Revelation from your Mystery and automatically gain Curse Boon I. Oracle 4: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 5: automatically gain Curse Boon II; any Mystery-specific level-5 feature recorded by the registry belongs to the Mystery module below and does not create an additional generic feature here. Oracle 6: choose one Tier II Revelation and gain Mystery Surge. Oracle 8: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 9: gain your Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation.

HERO-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 10: gain Curse Boon III and Grand Revelation Foreshadow. Oracle 11: RC cap reaches 7 and the preserved encounter-start RC floor becomes active. Oracle 12: gain the Mystery-specific Mystic Insight. Oracle 13: preserved registry draft grants a second Tier II Revelation; after each completed short rest choose which of your two Tier II Revelations is Attuned for features that specifically refer to an active Tier II option, though both remain known and usable. Oracle 14: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 15: gain Revelation Mastery and Curse Boon IV. Oracle 16: preserved Prophecy Trigger Mastery. Oracle 17: preserved Grand Revelation Foreshadow upgrade. Oracle 18: Prophetic Surge. Oracle 19: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 20: gain the Mystery's Final Revelation and Curse Boon V.

REVELATION MASTERY at level 15 never grants a Revelation you do not know. Choose one mastery enhancement explicitly listed by your Mystery for a Revelation you know. If a listed mastery names a Revelation you did not select, that mastery option is unavailable. Mastery cannot reduce RC below 0, create additional Actions beyond the shared cap or remove repeat-save requirements unless its exact Mystery text says so.

PROPHECY AND DIVINATION never force player beliefs, future choices or confessions. Information features can provide truthful clues, likely outcomes, symbolic visions or current facts, but the Director is not required to reveal unknowable future player decisions. Effects that command or compel a player-controlled character preserve the player's choice of targets and prohibit self-harm, permanent allegiance changes and belief alteration.

CURSE MANIFESTATION provides a common operational intensification rather than ten different hidden sub-engines. When activated, your Curse becomes visibly or metaphysically dominant for 3 rounds: gain +1 on Revelation attacks and +1 to Revelation save DC, but take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws for the duration. Any Curse limitation that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed during Manifestation.

CURSE BOONS are automatic at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 for your ONE selected Curse. You do not choose between Curse Boons and do not gain Boons from unselected Curses. Each Curse card below operationalizes all five Boon gates and its permanent limitations.

All class gates use Oracle class level, not total character level. Normal proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. Non-Oracle levels do not raise RC maximum, unlock Curse Boons, Revelations, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery, Prophetic Surge or Final Revelation.

INTEGRATION PRECEDENCE. The source ceiling draft conflicts with the registry on short rests and extra Revelation activations. This pilot explicitly chooses 1 RC on a completed short rest and permits a second Revelation only through an expressly granted extra Action or double-cast feature, never more than two Revelation resolutions per round. The preserved ceiling alternative is no short-rest recovery and one activation per round; do not combine both configurations.

All combat-triggered RC refunds, including Prophecy, damage riders and Curse Boons, share ONE recovered RC per round. Rest recovery, encounter-start floor and explicitly limited Final refills are separate. A free, copied or refunded use cannot recursively trigger another recovery. Apply this global cap even if an individual card says its recovery is separate.

The shared Prophetic Surge and your Mystery-specific level-18 Prophecy are two descriptions/options of ONE long-rest use, not two charges. Framework cards such as Tier III, Mystic Insight, Mastery and Final Revelation unlock the named Mystery card and never grant duplicate uses. A level-5 registry Mystery label grants no extra unnamed ability.

Oracle zone default: choose at most three allies and three enemies for each pulse or aura benefit, fixed at activation unless the card names fewer. Persistent damaging/healing zones require concentration and at most three pulses. Pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first, or end the effect; once-per-long-rest Finals include their printed pulses in that limited use. One pulse can affect a creature only once per round. Passive personal resistance and a single-target temporary buff are not zones.

Revelation backlash is the local one-turn penalty of -1 to attacks and saves and -5 feet Speed, ending at the end of your next turn. It is not a level of the general Exhaustion condition. Wound Eater's missed-feeding Exhaustion remains the general condition.

Initiative adjustments change order beginning next round. They never produce or erase a regular turn in the current round; a creature still gets at most one regular turn each round. Ties use the original initiative order. Fixed encounter-start bonuses do not retroactively reorder an encounter.

Extra attacks and echoed damage use base weapon/spell dice before critical-hit extra dice. A redirected damage event cannot be reduced a second time, reflected again or generate RC. Charmed alone does not grant command of a creature's actions.

Oracle’s exceptional ASI/feat schedule is 4, 8, 14 and 19. It does not gain extra ASIs at 12 or 16 from the generic class schedule. The rejected five-milestone draft remains in superseded Playtest Overrides for traceability.

engine: Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.

This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.

Preparation: two cantrips at 1, three at 4, four at 10, plus explicit Circle bonuses. Prepare class level+WIS modifier ranked Druid spells (minimum 1) each long rest, rank limited by Druid spell-rank access, not merely by enough RP. Use approved operational spell entries and Core V 2 RP table/costs in the shared configuration. Book rank-times-two cost and imported spell-slot terminology are preserved as superseded alternatives for this pilot. Circle always-prepared spells do not count toward preparation and use ordinary RP/Dissonance. Rituals must have ritual tag, be prepared and take printed casting time plus 10 minutes; waive base RP only, never consumed materials or other costs. ASI/feat milestones 4/8/12/16/19 belong to general advancement and must not be granted twice.

Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

Circle of the Land chooses one terrain at 2. Always-prepared spell pairs at 3/5/7/9 are exactly the source table lines 2662–2669, reproduced in source appendix; their source names resolve to existing approved spell entries before use. They do not bypass rank gates. For this pilot Circle spells are permitted exceptions to ordinary list membership, not newly authored variants. Moon Circle Forms CR table is historical external-stat language: use only these bounded forms, not arbitrary CR beasts. Early Moon benefit is +S damage on first form hit each turn. No imported monster multiattack, spellcasting or legendary actions.

Circle summary: Land preserves lore and recovery; Moon improves shifting; Storm controls lightning and wind; Thorns works poison and roots; Winterfang works cold; Rotshaper uses bounded swarms; Ashen Grove works fire and regrowth. Land/Thorns duplicate Blight Elk and Tanglemaw names are kept as separate source identities. Source auto-failed hostile saves in Master of Decay/Ash become once/turn-2 on one save, not unavoidable control. Stronger supplemental flavor riders are represented explicitly below or retained as unadopted alternatives in source provenance.

Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.

This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.

Preparation: two cantrips at 1, three at 4, four at 10, plus explicit Circle bonuses. Prepare class level+WIS modifier ranked Druid spells (minimum 1) each long rest, rank limited by Druid spell-rank access, not merely by enough RP. Use approved operational spell entries and Core V 2 RP table/costs in the shared configuration. Book rank-times-two cost and imported spell-slot terminology are preserved as superseded alternatives for this pilot. Circle always-prepared spells do not count toward preparation and use ordinary RP/Dissonance. Rituals must have ritual tag, be prepared and take printed casting time plus 10 minutes; waive base RP only, never consumed materials or other costs. ASI/feat milestones 4/8/12/16/19 belong to general advancement and must not be granted twice.

Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

Circle of the Land chooses one terrain at 2. Always-prepared spell pairs at 3/5/7/9 are exactly the source table lines 2662–2669, reproduced in source appendix; their source names resolve to existing approved spell entries before use. They do not bypass rank gates. For this pilot Circle spells are permitted exceptions to ordinary list membership, not newly authored variants. Moon Circle Forms CR table is historical external-stat language: use only these bounded forms, not arbitrary CR beasts. Early Moon benefit is +S damage on first form hit each turn. No imported monster multiattack, spellcasting or legendary actions.

Circle summary: Land preserves lore and recovery; Moon improves shifting; Storm controls lightning and wind; Thorns works poison and roots; Winterfang works cold; Rotshaper uses bounded swarms; Ashen Grove works fire and regrowth. Land/Thorns duplicate Blight Elk and Tanglemaw names are kept as separate source identities. Source auto-failed hostile saves in Master of Decay/Ash become once/turn-2 on one save, not unavoidable control. Stronger supplemental flavor riders are represented explicitly below or retained as unadopted alternatives in source provenance.

card.name: Rotting Touch
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it gains Decay for up to 3 rounds: attacks against it add S damage once per attacker per turn, it takes -1 on saving throws and cannot regain HP. At the end of each turn it repeats the save, ending Decay on success. Corpses within 2 tiles of a Decayed creature cannot be raised while Decay persists. If the target is undead, it also takes 2d6 necrotic damage on the initial hit and you regain half the actual damage dealt, capped at S+M HP. At most three allied hits per round receive the vulnerability rider; it is additional flat damage, not multiplication of an entire attack.

actual.name: Charm Person

operational.targets: One living person you can perceive within range
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it gains the CoreV2 Charmed condition toward you and regards you as friendly for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, and the first time each round you or your allies damage it, it repeats the Wisdom save; success ends the spell. On the initial save success, no effect.
operational.effect: Charm one person so it temporarily regards you as friendly. Charmed does not grant command authority, compel beliefs, reveal secrets, or force the target to obey requests.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: A player-controlled target retains full agency over choices and beliefs. The spell cannot force self-harm, confession, permanent allegiance, transfer of possessions, or actions beyond the CoreV2 Charmed restrictions. A creature that cannot be Charmed is unaffected. Only the first damage event each round grants the additional repeat save. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and Wisdom save are retained; F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Core lists Instantaneous duration, which conflicts with 'regards caster as friendly' and 'save ends early.' Concentration up to 1 minute and repeat-save cadence are NEW provisional operational decisions. Two source school placements are preserved externally; this record does not choose class access.

actual.name: Hypnotic Pattern

operational.targets: Choose a point you perceive with line of effect: within 60 feet for actual Enchantment casting access, or within 30 feet for actual Illusion casting access. Center a fixed 30-foot cube on that point, extending 15 feet along each axis. At resolution snapshot every creature physically in the cube with line of effect from its center that can actually see the pattern, including allies and yourself; no selective omission. The numeric range field records the maximum mode, not permission for Illusion to use 60 feet.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to one minute, with independent damage/rousing endings per affected creature. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it.
operational.resolution: Use the actual class’s school and rank-3/5-RP access. Enchantment access belongs to Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard and Paladin at their preserved levels; Monk’s actual mode is Illusion. Each eligible creature makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new components. Failure independently attempts Core Charmed toward you and actual Incapacitated. Charmed immunity blocks only Charmed; the Incapacitated component has its own defenses and shared hard-control allowance. A blocked hard component can leave independently legal Charmed. Apply the NEW spell-specific atomic initial batch in the shared rank-three manuscript: snapshot eligibility, resolve saves and legal components, apply every target’s components/immediate consequences, then process queued teardown of this Pattern if your own Incapacitated ended its concentration. Do not abort later targets because of iteration order.
operational.effect: Actual Charmed and Incapacitated retain their separate printed effects. Incapacitated ends applicable existing concentration and denies its ordinary covered action types; it does not inherently set Speed to 0. If self-Incapacitated ends your Pattern, other targets still receive that same initial batch and its real immediate consequences before this cast’s maintained components are removed. The visible lights remain in the fixed cube while concentration lasts but grant no general illumination, concealment or sight through obscurity. This is an initial snapshot: later entrants or initially ineligible creatures do not receive new applications. Later loss of sight does not end an existing application. End both still-present components from this cast on a creature when it receives positive post-defense/pre-temp-HP damage, or when another creature within physical reach uses an Action to rouse one selected Pattern application. Damage resolution preserves already-established hit/critical outcomes. No repeat saves.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: A fully prevented zero damage packet does not wake; a positive packet can wake even when temporary HP or an HP floor prevents ordinary HP loss. Rousing ends one actual cast’s application only, not every Pattern or unrelated condition source. If the helper cannot distinguish several Pattern applications, select one by stable application order without disclosing hidden source metadata. Recasts create independent sources subject to actual concentration transitions and each new hard-component check; an exact multiple-concentration feature does not convert them into refreshes. A Charmed-only remnant receives no invented repeat save. No unaware, Unconscious, Prone, Speed 0 or forced item drop is added. Ordinary darkness/obscurity can prevent initial actual sight even though the pattern itself is visible. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both schools/rank-3/5-RP class access, Action/V/S/F, Enchantment range 60 and Illusion range 30, concentration minute, Charmed/Incapacitated; Illusion supplies 30-foot cube and WIS. NEW: harmonized cube/save for Enchantment, perceived center/center-LoE/sight snapshot, separate components, waking, and spell-specific atomic self-concentration cleanup. No unprinted Speed 0 or entry aura is imported.

operational.duration: Concentration, up to one minute. In initiative the maximum ends at the caster’s tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. operational.resolution: On successful resolution create up to four nonphysical torch-sized lights at the chosen points. One active Dancing Lights application per caster across school placements. A successful new application replaces that caster’s prior set; normal concentration transition may already have ended it at new cast commitment, and a countered cast restores nothing.
operational.effect: Each light provides real ordinary illumination: bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. This is usable illumination even from an actual Illusion placement. As one existing Bonus Action, consciously move any/all surviving lights once, each along a continuous non-solid path no longer than 30 feet. Each new destination must be perceived with line of effect from the caster and within 60 feet. The path may curve around obstacles but never pass through solid matter, teleport or exceed its actual distance budget. The 60-foot caster-to-light tether is checked continuously during movement of caster or light: exceeding it ends that light immediately, even if a proposed path would later return. One light ending leaves the rest. Losing caster-to-light line of effect after creation does not itself end an unmoving light; it still illuminates subject to ordinary physical barriers. A later command still needs its destination’s perception/line of effect. Lights otherwise stay at their points; no automatic following, formation lock or autonomous movement.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: Opaque barriers block ordinary illumination. Overlapping sets/radii do not add together into greater range or a higher light category merely by stacking. No heat, fuel, sunlight trait, damage, physical object, collision, attachment, automatic Invisible/Hidden revelation or generic magical-darkness dispel. Ordinary lighting can remove mundane darkness as the actual reason something was unseen; other concealment/senses remain. Commands grant no extra Bonus Action. Loss of concentration, actual removal or expiry ends the relevant lights; a stale endpoint of an older replaced set cannot erase its replacement. Actual multiple-concentration features do not bypass the one-set-per-caster cap. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base rank 0 costs 0 RP but does not waive real extra costs or Refrain. V requires audible speech; S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception. No F is added. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Evocation/Illusion placements and class access, Action, 30-foot creation range, V/S, up to four torch-sized lights. NEW: concentration minute replacing Instantaneous placeholder, real 10-foot bright/additional10dim radii, Bonus Action movement up to30, continuous60foot tether and no ongoing-LoE destruction. actual.name: Mirror Image

operational.targets: Self; creates 3 illusory duplicates occupying your space and moving with you
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute or until all 3 duplicates are destroyed
operational.resolution: When an attack roll directly targets you, randomly select among you and all remaining duplicates with equal probability before the attack roll. If you are selected, resolve the attack against you normally. If a duplicate is selected, resolve the attack roll against your current AC; on a hit that duplicate is destroyed, and on a miss it remains. Area effects ignore the duplicates.
operational.effect: Create three illusory duplicates of yourself. Direct attack rolls may strike a duplicate instead of you until the duplicates are destroyed or concentration ends.
operational.scaling: None; always creates 3 duplicates.
operational.limitations: Duplicates have no Actions, HP, independent positions, attacks, bodies, cover, collision, resource triggers, or ability to intercept saving-throw effects. They cannot be deliberately targeted by you or allies to generate procs. A creature that does not rely on sight or explicitly ignores visual illusions targets you normally. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: The two Core V2 entries conflict: one gives 30-foot range and concentration up to 1 minute, while the other gives Self and Instantaneous. Because the source consistently says duplicates of yourself, this pilot uses self range and retains the coherent 1-minute concentration duration. V/S/M/F is represented as a small reflective token or existing class casting focus. Equal random selection and duplicate-hit procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.

actual.name: Silent Image

operational.targets: One static visual illusion fitting entirely inside a 15-foot cube whose nearest point is within range
operational.resolution: The illusion appears automatically. A creature that uses an Action to scrutinize it makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the image as illusory.
operational.effect: Create a static visual illusion contained within a 15-foot cube. It may depict creatures, objects, structures, surfaces, or visible phenomena, but it produces no sound, smell, heat, force, or physical substance.
operational.scaling: None.

Investigation vs Spell DC is the mechanical disbelief procedure. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. Physical passage through the image reveals its lack of substance to the interacting creature; no check is required to recognize that direct evidence. A known illusion grants no mechanical cover or blocked line of sight.

F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Exact Investigation disbelief and nonphysical limitations are NEW provisional illusion mechanics.

actual.name: Feather Fall

operational.targets: Up to 5 willing falling creatures you can perceive within range
operational.duration: Until each target lands, stops falling, or immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting (1 minute), whichever occurs first
operational.resolution: None; willing legal targets are affected automatically.
operational.effect: Slow each target's downward descent to at most 60 feet at each once-per-round Fall Marker. Use the new provisional falling bridge in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md: dissipate prior uncontrolled momentum on application; if landing while this spell is active, impact is min(3, floor(total distance descended in this fall / 20))d6 bludgeoning. This impact limit is a new playtest decision, not recovered spell text.
operational.scaling: None; maximum descent remains 60 feet per round and target cap remains 5.
operational.limitations: Grants no flight, hovering, lateral movement or automatic safe landing. A creature ceases to be affected once it lands or is no longer Falling. Targets cannot be added after casting. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. This Action requires targets still Falling when a legal Action is available; it cannot undo an impact. On expiry aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero and resume ordinary descent at the existing marker with no immediate extra step. Expiry resolves before a coincident Falling Step.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 consistently gives Action, 60-foot range, V/S/F components and the five-creature/60-feet-per-round effect, but lists Instantaneous duration despite sustained descent. Duration, initiative marker, momentum handling and impact formula are NEW provisional decisions agreed with the GPT notebook. See SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for the full procedure and source-search limits. This does not import a Reaction casting time or automatic fall-damage immunity. F is an existing class casting focus.

actual.name: Shapechange

operational.targets: Self
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Choose one legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile on cast. No save. Once on each of your original regular turns afterward, you may use a Bonus Action to switch to a different legal profile. The new anatomy must fit the available space. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath. No internal switch on the casting turn or an extra turn; first switch is the next original regular turn, then at most one on each later original regular turn.
operational.effect: You retain your identity, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, resources, initiative and existing effects. Only your current anatomy/profile changes. Each supplied natural attack uses your current spell attack bonus and M. Profile switching does not create a new body, heal, refresh resources, restore temporary HP or reset rest/recharge uses.
operational.scaling: No automatic scaling beyond the bounded R4+R9 profile register.
operational.limitations: Only one Shapechange anatomy exists at a time. An identical-profile switch is rejected before Bonus Action payment. Internal switches are not spell casts and do not create new Dissonance or Refrain events. Equipment remains melded through switches. Losing flight while unsupported begins ordinary falling. Actual 0 HP, death or Incapacitated after same-packet prevention ends Shapechange without healing. The spell grants no Druid Buffer Reserve, Form Surge, Shapeshift use or Druid form features. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Shapechange identity, Rank 9, Druid/Mage/Wizard access and class-specific schools, Action, source 120-foot metadata, V/S/F, base 26 RP, and the core concept of changing creature form each round. NEW: operational target narrowed to Self, one-minute concentration, Bonus Action once-per-original-regular-turn switching, finite R4/R9 profiles and same-body state rules. The original 120-foot source field remains preserved in provenance despite the self-target operational narrowing.

actual.name: Counterspell

operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Abjuration/Universal rank-3 placements, Reaction, 60 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous interruption. NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes. Exact source permission may override the shared attempt limit; another Reaction alone cannot.

actual.name: Magic Circle

operational.targets: One fixed center point on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface you can perceive within range and line of effect, with space for a 10-foot-radius circle.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Choose one exact current source-authorized creature type/tag. No saving throw. The initial lateral boundary cannot intersect a matching creature's occupied space.
operational.effect: Create a visible 10-foot-radius circle with a 10-foot-high lateral cylindrical boundary. Matching creatures outside cannot physically cross that lateral boundary inward. Matching creatures already inside may remain or leave freely; once outside, their re-entry is blocked. Carriage does not bypass the restriction. Both actual Abjuration and Universal class placements use this same procedure.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: No inferred taxonomy, reverse trapping mode, Action denial, antimagic, HP, damage or structural support. Objects, attacks, spells, sound, gas and nonmatching creatures are not blocked. No magical roof or floor: travel over the top or legitimately beneath the wall is outside it. Teleportation/planar relocation is not physical crossing and is not prevented. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested or given extra movement. If unsupported Falling leaves a matching creature overlapping the lateral boundary, and it had a determinate legal side immediately before that overlap, it must clear the overlap back to that side using ordinary legal movement. If it descended from above with no determinate prior side, it may clear the overlap to either side using ordinary legal movement. Clearing overlap grants no free movement or subsequent permission to re-enter through the boundary. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both rank-3 placements, Action, 10-foot cast range and 10-foot-radius circle/cylinder; M/F uses F. NEW CONFLICT RULING: concentration 1 minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: 10-foot height, one exact type, inward-only side boundary, existing occupants, teleport and no-support rules.

actual.name: Dispel Magic

operational.targets: One individually perceptible ongoing magical effect within range and line of effect, generated by a spell of actual recorded rank 0 through 3.
operational.resolution: Automatic for an eligible effect; no saving throw or check.
operational.effect: End only the selected effect and invoke its ordinary ending procedure and dependencies. Its original generating spell rank controls, using its caster's class placement when class-cast; RP cost, discount, caster level and the dispeller's access do not alter it. Both actual Abjuration and Universal placements use this rank ceiling.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: No permanent enchantment or magic-item removal, class-engine or creature-trait removal, mass purge, retroactive healing/resource repair, or guessing an unknown spell rank. A curse qualifies only when it is itself an otherwise eligible ongoing spell effect within the rank ceiling and is not specially protected. Mere binary awareness of nearby magic does not identify a selectable individual effect. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous and both rank-3 placements. NEW CONFLICT RULING: Core Tier 3 means spell rank at most 3; the Universal generic description grants neither unlimited-rank dispelling nor a mass purge. One selected effect per cast.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending

actual.name: Identify

operational.targets: One magical object or ongoing magical effect you can see within 30 feet
operational.resolution: None.
operational.effect: Learn the target's publicly knowable magical function: its broad school or magical category if any, ordinary activation method, numerical bonuses or penalties exposed by the effect, whether it requires attunement or equivalent bonding, and the remaining count of explicitly tracked finite charges if that information is not protected by the item's rules.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Does not automatically reveal curses, hidden sentience, passwords, historical provenance, secret Director-only functions, artifact plot conditions, concealed transformations, future consequences, protected command words, or information an effect explicitly blocks from divination. An explicit ward may register as obscured if its rules say so; hidden properties alone do not reveal their own existence. Cannot identify mundane craftsmanship beyond ordinary observation. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 blocks and catalog summaries are preserved alongside this card. Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core Action and30ft restored; no automatic secret or curse disclosure. An expressly hidden property remains hidden, without automatically revealing that a hidden property exists.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional 1-minute examination procedure and public/secret information boundary. Source requirement to reveal/determine magical properties is preserved without assuming imported spell-block behavior.

Detecting an aura does not grant line of effect or permission to target through barriers. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.

Components use the existing class focus where Core says F or M/F; this focus interpretation is provisional. Exact target eligibility, duration endpoints, saves where absent, concentration where unclear and anti-loop limits are provisional integration decisions. Core instantaneous metadata cannot sustain the described perception; this pilot uses explicit concentration for up to10minutes. The30ft range limits perception of spell-granted information.

operational.targets: Self; one specific object personally familiar to you through at least 1 minute of prior direct observation or handling
operational.resolution: None.

operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Provides direction only, not exact distance, route, floor, container, bearer identity, object condition, surrounding creatures, or a path around barriers. Fails if the object is outside 1,000 feet, on another plane, transformed beyond recognition into a different object, or protected by an effect explicitly blocking divination. Repeated casts cannot reveal protected/secret facts beyond the object's direction. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Conference decision: casting range0/self is separate from the source effect's1000ft detection radius. Preserve conflicting Universal30ft metadata as evidence. Ten-minute concentration and familiarity threshold are provisional specifications; no exact location, distance or hidden properties are revealed.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional familiarity requirement, 10-minute concentration duration, and divination limits. Source 1,000-foot directional location of a familiar object is preserved despite conflicting source placement levels.

actual.name: True Polymorph

operational.targets: One eligible physical creature or one eligible discrete nonmagical unattended object within 120 feet
operational.duration: Concentration during a 1-minute shaping period; if maintained for the full minute, the transformation persists until dispelled without further concentration; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Choose creature-to-creature, willing-creature-to-object, object-to-creature, or object-to-object before payment. Creature-to-creature may affect an unwilling target on a failed Constitution save; while shaping, that target repeats the save at each original regular end and once per numbered round after positive actual HP damage. Creature-to-object requires willingness. Objects make no save. If concentration survives the full shaping minute, the result becomes persistent until dispelled. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath.
operational.effect: Creature transformations retain one identity and one HP/durability history. Creature-to-creature uses any legal R4 or R9 spell-form profile. Creature-to-object creates one inert mundane object anatomy without healing or a new durability pool. Object-to-creature uses the object's existing structural HP as its one durability ledger and creates a controlled no-soul companion using an eligible non-humanoid R4/R9 profile and the caster's snapshotted spell statistics. Object-to-object changes only mundane form/material within the bounded utility restrictions.
operational.scaling: No automatic scaling. Permanent attack/DC values supplied by this spell snapshot the original caster's spell attack, spell DC and M when cast. Snapshot PB and source class as well. All True Polymorph supplied attack/DC values use this snapshot from casting, including shaping.
operational.limitations: No mode creates XP, loot, a soul, resurrection entitlement, valuable material, consumable stock, ammunition, currency, medicine, food or magical properties. Carried, worn, attuned, magical, artifact, structural-terrain and undefined-durability objects are ineligible. Object-origin creatures cannot receive ordinary HP healing as a means of repairing their source object. Only one active object-origin True Polymorph creature per caster is permitted. Such a creature shares the owner's companion Bonus Action/offensive budget and gains no independent turn/resources. Permanent True Polymorph does not end at 0 HP merely to restore the original form. Death/destruction remains real; later dispelling changes anatomy only and never heals, resurrects or recreates missing matter. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted. Object origin and earliest physical identity persist through every transformation chain. Object-origin creatures never gain a humanoid profile, soul, ordinary healing, resurrection or biological/class/rest resources. Use one actual structural HP ledger; structural0 destroys the object and ends its creature manifestation. Creature-origin object anatomy is actionless, not automatically Incapacitated. Allowed object templates are barrier/slab, ramp/wedge, open-container, static-furniture or simple-one-piece-tool; no actuated mechanism, magical or valuable output. Output size Tiny..Large and within one category of input; output mass cannot exceed recorded input or earliest origin mass; value cannot exceed original documented ceiling. Corpses/remains, magical/attuned/carried/worn/attended/structural objects and undefined structural durability are ineligible. An object-creature reserves its original caster slot on successful shaping; suppression/control change never frees it. At the60-second boundary finish damage, resolve due repeat save, then stabilize only surviving links. Replacing an active True object anatomy requires legal True replacement, not fresh nonmagical/unattended outside-object admission. Creature-origin people retain their CON save against unwilling creature-profile recasts and must consent to object-profile recasts. Returning them to creature anatomy grants no companion slot.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: True Polymorph identity, Rank 9, exact class access/schools, Action, 120 feet, V/S/F, base 26 RP, creature/object scope and meaningful until-dispelled permanence. NEW: one-minute shaping/stabilization procedure, save/agency rules, bounded form register, object eligibility/size/value rules, object-origin companion contract, one controlled-object-creature cap, durability conservation and destruction/dispel semantics.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED operational-playtest draft
