Such a creature shares the owner's companion Bonus Action/offensive budget and gains no independent turn/resources. Permanent True Polymorph does not end at 0 HP merely to restore the original form. Death/destruction remains real; later dispelling changes anatomy only and never heals, resurrects or recreates missing matter. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted. Object origin and earliest physical identity persist through every transformation chain. Object-origin creatures never gain a humanoid profile, soul, ordinary healing, resurrection or biological/class/rest resources. Use one actual structural HP ledger; structural0 destroys the object and ends its creature manifestation. Creature-origin object anatomy is actionless, not automatically Incapacitated. Allowed object templates are barrier/slab, ramp/wedge, open-container, static-furniture or simple-one-piece-tool; no actuated mechanism, magical or valuable output. Output size Tiny..Large and within one category of input; output mass cannot exceed recorded input or earliest origin mass; value cannot exceed original documented ceiling. Corpses/remains, magical/attuned/carried/worn/attended/structural objects and undefined structural durability are ineligible. An object-creature reserves its original caster slot on successful shaping; suppression/control change never frees it. At the60-second boundary finish damage, resolve due repeat save, then stabilize only surviving links. Replacing an active True object anatomy requires legal True replacement, not fresh nonmagical/unattended outside-object admission. Creature-origin people retain their CON save against unwilling creature-profile recasts and must consent to object-profile recasts. Returning them to creature anatomy grants no companion slot.

NEW: one-minute shaping/stabilization procedure, save/agency rules, bounded form register, object eligibility/size/value rules, object-origin companion contract, one controlled-object-creature cap, durability conservation and destruction/dispel semantics.

actual.name: Find Familiar

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Small spirit familiar
operational.resolution: No initial roll. The familiar's commanded attack uses your spell attack bonus.
operational.effect: Summon one Small spirit familiar using the shared standard companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP equal to 2 times your class level, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee or ranged attack with 5-foot reach or 30-foot range using your spell attack bonus and dealing S d6 damage of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage (choose one type and melee or ranged mode on casting; keep them fixed for that summon). It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command it to move and make its one attack or take another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.
operational.scaling: Uses the shared companion profile: AC increases with PB, HP equals 2×class level, and attack damage is S d6 at class levels 1/5/11/17.
operational.limitations: All companions you own share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The familiar gains no unstated flight, invisibility, telepathy, special senses, resistances, immunities, spell delivery, independent spellcasting, Help-based automatic advantage, loot, wages, corpse, resource generation, death trigger, or free resummon benefit. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior familiar from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. The source provides no specific familiar statistics, so the existing shared standard-companion profile is used rather than importing another game's familiar block. Command range/perception and anti-loop limits follow the current playtest companion interface.

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; creates one invisible noncombat helper force
operational.resolution: None.
operational.effect: Create an invisible force that can move at Speed 30 feet and perform simple mundane tasks you could direct an unskilled helper to perform, such as carrying up to 10 pounds, opening an unlocked door, fetching an unattended object, sweeping, cleaning, arranging mundane items, holding a light object, or operating a simple harmless mechanism. It obeys simple instructions while within 60 feet and able to receive your verbal directions. Giving or changing an instruction in combat uses your Bonus Action and shares the companion command budget; it performs at most one simple noncombat object interaction on that turn. It cannot make attacks or grant the Help action. The servant has a notional location but occupies no space, blocks no movement and provides no cover. It performs its commanded interaction only on an object within 5 feet of that location.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: The servant is not a combat creature and cannot attack, deal damage, impose conditions, provide flanking, make skill checks requiring proficiency or judgment, use weapons, traps, bombs, poisons, healing items, spell items, or other combat consumables, activate class abilities, cast spells, create commodities, perform paid labor that generates free wages or economic output, craft valuable goods, carry creatures, trigger resource/death effects, or serve as physical cover. It cannot manipulate attended objects against resistance. You may maintain only one Unseen Servant at a time. It has no corporeal HP or body and cannot intercept damage; it can be ended by an effect explicitly dispelling or suppressing the sustaining spell. Recasting replaces it and pays the full RP cost.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S/F components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite creating an ongoing helper. One-hour duration, Speed 30, 10-pound carrying limit, 60-foot command range, and explicit noncombat-helper boundaries are NEW provisional mechanics. actual.name: Harmonic Bulwark

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within 60 feet
operational.duration: Cast instantaneous; accepted temporary HP last until depleted, replaced, or the recipient completes a long rest
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal payment; temporary-HP strongest-only arbitration then applies.
operational.effect: The chosen willing recipient receives a temporary-HP offer equal to 5 times credited RP. Credited RP is actual base RP paid after exact legal base-cost reductions plus chosen additional X from0..PB. X cannot be discounted. Ordinary surcharges never count toward credited RP. Use canonical ordinary-cast pricing; Refrain changes post-cast Dissonance and is not a new RP surcharge.
operational.scaling: 5 temporary HP per credited RP. Additional conversion RP X is capped by proficiency bonus and must actually be paid.
operational.limitations: Additional conversion RP cannot itself be discounted. Payment occurs before nonstack arbitration and is not refunded when a stronger or equal shield remains. A cast with zero credited RP is illegal. Free casts/copies that spend no credited RP create no fresh Harmonic Bulwark shield unless their own exact copy rule expressly copies an already-resolved temporary-HP event. Temporary HP are not healing and use the canonical one-active-buffer rule. Choose X before commitment. Commit Action plus quoted casting payment plus X before countering or arbitration; no post-commit refund. A countered spell offers nothing.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Harmonic Bulwark identity, Universal Rank 3, class access/learn levels/base 5 RP, and 5 temporary HP per RP source wording. NEW: Action, 60-foot range, one willing target, V/S/F components, PB cap on discretionary RP, exact credited-RP accounting, and V6-default shield lifetime. Action/range/components resemble the unproven Mana Shield candidate but are adopted only as provisional Harmonic Bulwark design choices; the alias is not treated as source identity.

actual.name: Slow

operational.targets: Actual Enchantment mode: choose up to six creatures you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. Actual Transmutation mode: the triggering creature must be perceived within 60 feet and line of effect and must be selected; choose up to five additional such creatures. The actual casting class determines school/mode; paying the same rank-3/base-5-RP price never grants the other package.
operational.duration: Both modes: concentration, up to one minute. In initiative, the maximum ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. If begun outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; no timing-mode change resets it.
operational.resolution: Enchantment uses an Action and an independent Wisdom save per target. Transmutation uses a Reaction when a creature you perceive within 60 feet/line of effect begins a distinct voluntary movement segment or begins an Action on its own actual turn, after required declaration/commitment and before the segment’s first step or Action’s first main outcome. An extra turn can trigger; Bonus Actions and Reactions cannot. Transmutation gives each chosen target an independent Constitution save. Success: no new effect for that target. Failure: apply only that actual mode’s independently defended rider set. Each affected creature repeats that mode’s recorded WIS or CON save at every affected regular-turn END, including the current regular turn if applied during it; success ends that cast’s application on that creature. Extra turns grant no ending saves. Outside initiative an otherwise legally established ongoing effect uses the specifically bound six-second END-save cadence, never a new Reaction trigger.
operational.effect: Enchantment failure: half Speed under existing strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration; -2 AC; -2 Dexterity ability checks and Dexterity saving throws, expressly excluding initiative; and at most one full Action commitment per actual turn. It changes no DEX score/modifier, DEX attack/damage, spell DC or other unnamed derived statistic. AC has only its separate -2. Count an Action already committed before application toward the ceiling; an already-legally-committed second Action still finishes, but no further Action can be committed that turn. The ceiling applies independently on extra turns; it retains Bonus Actions, Reactions and inherent attacks in a legal Attack Action. Transmutation failure: half Speed, -2 AC and no future Reaction commitments. It imposes no DEX penalty or Action ceiling. Already-committed unresolved Reactions remain on the LIFO stack. Neither mode grants unprinted spell delay, attack-count restriction, Action/Bonus-Action interchange, cancellation or teleport restriction.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Transmutation’s movement trigger is one distinct segment, such as moving, performing an Action, then resuming movement; choosing another square during continuous movement is not a new segment, and individual feet/tiles are never new triggers. A paid Slow remains independent if a legal nested interruption removes the original parent Action: resolve it against still-legal selected targets, without refund, revival or parent cancellation. A surviving parent Action continues after the interrupt stack; movement recalculates remaining legal allowance before the next expenditure, keeping all movement already spent. The one-Action ceiling, Reaction denial and other soft riders do not claim whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual narrowly scoped defenses can suppress individual components. Each cast/mode retains separate caster, concentration, saves and deadline. Half-Speed records compete against the same pre-control Speed, then existing later systemic multipliers apply. Identical Slow -2 AC and DEX penalties do not add; independent Enchantment and Transmutation casts may supply their distinct surviving riders together. Enchantment access: Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard, Paladin. Transmutation access: Dragoon, Druid, Mage, Monk, Ranger, Shaman, Tinker. Preserve each exact minimum class level. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both school/rank-3 modes, 60 feet, V/S/F, up to six targets; Enchantment Action/half Speed/-2 AC/-2 DEX/one action, and Transmutation Reaction/half Speed/-2 AC/no Reactions. NEW: WIS versus CON, concentration minute/repeat END saves, explicit distinct-segment/Action Reaction window with mandatory triggering target, scoped DEX exception and full-Action ceiling. No mode union from a single cast; independent overlaps keep provenance.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader integration pending

actual.name: Polymorph

operational.targets: One physical creature you can perceive within 60 feet
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Choose one legal R4 spell-form profile and validate its space before payment. A willing target may waive its save. An unwilling target makes a Constitution save against your spell DC. On failure it transforms. At the end of each of its original regular turns, and once per numbered round after it suffers positive actual HP damage, it may repeat the save; success ends the transformation. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath.
operational.effect: Replace the target's current anatomy with the chosen R4 spell-form profile while preserving one body, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, identity, resources, initiative and condition clocks. The supplied form attack uses the original caster's current spell attack bonus and M. Equipment melds and is unavailable unless a separate anatomy-compatible passive bonus is certified. The target retains control of all decisions.
operational.scaling: No automatic profile, damage, target-count or duration scaling. Use only the bounded R4 spell-form register.
operational.limitations: No monster stat block, multiattack, class spellcasting, legendary power, new resource pool or second HP pool is gained. Speech, hands and movement come only from the selected profile. A willing target may spend its Action on its regular turn to end its own Polymorph. Actual 0 HP, death or Incapacitated after same-packet prevention resolves ends the spell without healing. Explicit transformation immunity and legendary defenses apply normally. Natural/form attacks do not automatically qualify for unrelated weapon-only features. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Polymorph identity, Transmutation Rank 4, exact class access, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and base 7 RP. NEW: one-minute concentration, target/save/repeat-save procedure, R4 finite profile list, same-body state retention, caster-derived form attack, equipment/anatomy rules and zero-HP reversion.

operational.targets: Up to 10 distinct physical creatures you can perceive within 120 feet
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; absolute checkpoint at casting timestamp +60 seconds, never extended by extra turns
operational.resolution: Before payment choose 1-10 targets and one legal R4 spell-form profile for each, validating each possible anatomy's space. Willing targets may waive saves. Each unwilling target independently makes a Constitution save. Failure creates that target's transformation link. Each hostile transformed target repeats the save at its original regular-turn end and once per numbered round after positive actual HP damage. Success ends only that target's link. Use the complete TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md procedure and finite spell_form_profiles.json register. Preflight all targets, anatomy, space and access before committing Action/RP; commit ends your old concentration before counters or saves. A failed or countered new spell does not restore old concentration. An anatomy from another source is replaced only on actual success. No displaced form remains underneath. Before payment validate O/O, O/T, T/O and T/T footprint compatibility for every pair of targets; saves resolve independently and successful anatomy changes apply simultaneously.
operational.effect: Each failed/waived target gains exactly one selected R4 anatomy while retaining its own identity, current/max HP, temporary HP, Wounds, conditions, attributes, proficiency, resources, initiative and condition clocks. Each target's supplied natural attack uses the original caster's current spell attack bonus and M. All transformed targets share one concentration record but otherwise resolve their own transformation endings independently.
operational.scaling: Exactly up to 10 creatures. No generic three-target cap and no automatic access to the R9-only greater/elemental profiles.
operational.limitations: Casting range and line of effect are checked only when the spell is committed; there is no ongoing range tether. One target ending does not end another. Concentration ending removes every remaining target transformation. No target gains monster stat blocks, multiattack, resources, class features or a second HP pool. Equipment/anatomy, natural-attack taxonomy, damage/reversion and agency follow the shared spell-transformation chassis. The subject owns supplied natural-attack events; the original caster supplies attack statistics. These attacks are not spell casts or automatically caster spell-damage/kill triggers. A Druid cannot enter Shapeshift while a spell anatomy is active. Temporary lower-rank spells cannot replace higher-rank anatomy. Only a successful True Polymorph or an exact named exception can replace permanent True anatomy. Antimagic suppresses the same record while concentration and its absolute clock continue; True Polymorph can stabilize while suppressed. Suppression never frees an object-companion slot or resets gear. Creature-origin type tags remain unchanged; profile names confer no creature type. Every supplied attack has5-foot reach. Original anatomical abilities unavailable in the selected profile do not persist underneath it. A successful new transformation closes the old record and atomically restores/recaptures still-existing original gear; internal profile switches instead retain the same meld set and drop incompatible external gear. Mandatory reversion returns at the same anchor; blocked placement is referred to canonical geometry without automatic teleport or crushing damage. Original melded gear remains inaccessible under antimagic. A willing temporary creature-origin recipient can use its regular-turn rejection Action while suppressed if its root creature anatomy can act; object-origin identities gain no rejection right. No generic magical-attack bypass flag is granted.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Mass Polymorph identity, Transmutation Rank 9, Druid/Mage/Wizard level-17 access, Action, 120 feet, V/S/F, base 26 RP and explicit up-to-10-creature scope. NEW: one-minute concentration, preselected per-target R4 profiles, independent saves/endings, no ongoing tether and shared same-body transformation rules.

actual.name: Speak with Dead

operational.targets: One perceived corpse or substantial apparent creature remains within 60 feet and line of effect; eligibility of its deceased identity and retained memories resolves after casting costs commit.
operational.duration: Up to 1 minute or until five question exchanges are spent; no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No save or willing-soul gate. After costs commit, determine whether these are sufficient actual remains of one currently dead creature identity to support an associated retained memory echo. Bones or equivalent substantial creature remains can qualify without an intact mouth, tongue or biological flesh. An active Undead/Construct, an ordinary broken device that was never a creature, identityless ash, a stray blood trace or old remains of a currently living identity do not qualify. If no readable qualifying echo exists, obtain no answers without learning which eligibility/protection fact failed.
operational.effect: Invoke a retained memory echo associated with the addressed remains and deceased identity, not a soul, creature or resurrection. For this application you may spend up to five question exchanges. Each attempted materially unified inquiry and its answer uses one Action in initiative, or approximately six elapsed seconds outside initiative, and one question allowance; the original casting Action includes no free question. Distinct independent subquestions require their own exchanges, Actions and allowances even when spoken as one sentence. You must audibly address the remains from within 60 feet and line of effect; ordinary sound-blocking conditions apply. Each committed exchange spends its allowance even if the question is not understood or its answer is unknown/protected. The echo answers audibly from the remains, truthfully according to the deceased’s actual associated memories and beliefs before death. It uses a language the deceased knew and would reasonably use, with no automatic translation. If no mutually usable language or remembered answer supports a response, it may provide no intelligible answer, I do not know, I do not remember, or the appropriate equivalent. It cannot deliberately lie or withhold a known readable answer from hostility, but mistaken beliefs remain mistaken.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Actual memories associated with the remains govern: this grants no post-death knowledge or automatic later-life memory update to an older fragment after resurrection and another death. Multiple fragments remain one deceased identity, not new people or duplicated souls. A fresh legal paid cast can ask another five; no daily immunity or exclusive global interview slot is added. Each application retains its own quota and deadline; asking an echo does not simultaneously question all other applications. The echo ends if the identity becomes living, the selected physical anchor no longer contains qualifying remains, the five exchanges are spent, or the spell expires/is actually ended. A temporary gap in speaking/range/sound/line of effect pauses no duration. Existing answers and ordinary remembered information persist after ending. Soul Bind or a resurrection-only blocker does not automatically block this memory echo; actual corpse, communication, memory or information protections keep their written scope. The spell generates Divination through Cleric, Mirrorsage, Ranger, Shaman, Wizard or Paladin, and Necromancy through Crimson Agent, Druid or Thief, exactly as the selected casting class’s access row states. A Divination-only ward cannot block a Necromancy cast merely because this shared identity has another school placement. Protection may also filter new information about a separately protected subject within its actual scope. No compelled living creature, identity creation, body animation, healing, resource refresh, skill/proficiency download, objective-history verification or usable recording token results. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both rank-three Divination/Necromancy source placements and five questions/answers; Core M/F uses shared F. NEW: retained-memory echo, substantial-remains eligibility, truthful subjective answers and one-minute interview. Exact completions put hidden eligibility after payment, require separate paid Action/question exchanges after casting, retain local audible inquiry/range, and bind memories to the actual associated remains rather than silently updating old fragments across later lives.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, numerical balance and broader system validation pending

actual.name: Chill Touch

operational.targets: One creature you perceive and can physically touch within your actual legal reach, with line of effect. The 5-foot reference describes ordinary Touch reach; no extended reach is granted. Use the actual Evocation or Necromancy placement available to the chosen class; access is not unioned.
operational.duration: Instantaneous damage; one target-round broad current-HP-gain prohibition, no concentration. The rider ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding its entire current turn if already underway. Outside initiative it ends six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or outside absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; end-phase events precede expiry cleanup.
operational.resolution: Make one melee spell attack. Miss: no damage or restriction. Hit: deal 1d8 necrotic and establish the independent HP-gain prohibition under its actual defenses.
operational.effect: While affected, any event increasing the target’s current HP produces 0 gain: spell/feature/potion healing, passive regeneration, natural recovery, natural-20 death-save 1HP, Stable-state 1HP and other direct restoration. Apply HEALING_DEATH_PLAYTEST.md: ordinary healing’s legal amount and genuine excess become0; ordinary activation costs remain committed, while a reserve spent only for actual restored HP spends0. Independent non-HP components still resolve. A blocked natural20 uses the already-reviewed bridge: Stable at0, death counters cleared, immediate d4-hour recovery deadline and preserved used-turn marker. A due Stable1HP recovery remains subject to its existing blocked-deadline procedure; this spell never rerolls or resets that deadline.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No Undead/biological target prerequisite or special Undead rider. The prohibition does not itself block stabilization, successful death-save state changes, temporary HP, condition removal, damage prevention, maximum-HP changes or independent non-HP components. A maximum-HP change does not authorize a separate current-HP increase through this prohibition. Actual resurrection returned HP is the existing LIFE TRANSITION exception and is not blocked; no corpse/soul/resurrection seal is created. Actual death/condition-removal procedures retain their scope, without duplicating an identity or refreshing spent resources. This is an HP-state rule, not a cosmology ruling. A hit establishes the independent rider under its own defenses even if the damage is reduced to 0; immunity to the damage type alone does not prevent that rider. A later independent application retains its own endpoint; ending one removes only that application, and equal penalties/prohibitions do not stack magnitude. Actual class/source access, repertoire, action availability, components, RP, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions, paid commitment and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base rank 0 costs 0 RP but does not waive real extra costs or Refrain. V requires audible speech; S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception. No F is added. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles only actual damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. An illegal uncommitted attempt supplies no effect; a legally paid cast countered or failing afterward refunds nothing. Actual damage/material/condition defenses retain their own scopes. No automatic level scaling, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Evocation/Necromancy sources and actual access, Action, Touch, V/S, 1d8 necrotic and cannot regain HP. NEW: melee spell attack, hit-based independent broad current-HP-gain prohibition, explicit future-target-END duration, state-recovery bindings and existing resurrection life-transition boundary. Authoring clarification deliberately refines initial conference healing-only wording to the source’s broader HP-gain scope.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader integration pending

operational.resolution: No initial roll. The skeleton's commanded melee attack uses your spell attack bonus.

actual.name: Death Ward

operational.targets: One living creature you can perceive within range and line of effect
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; ends when its prevention is used
operational.resolution: No initial save. While the spell remains active, the first eligible effect that would reduce the target from positive HP to 0 without Core Instant Death or another outright-death result instead leaves it at 1 HP; then the ward ends.
operational.effect: Prevent one positive-to-zero HP crossing. Preserve the raw damage packet, Core Instant Death check, half-maximum/Maiming Wound triggers and attached conditions. The prevented positive-to-zero crossing does not itself create a drop-only Wound save. This is loss prevention, not healing, so a cannot-regain-HP effect does not stop it. Other eligible survival effects are rechecked after the selected prevention resolves; no duplicate automatic use is consumed after the crossing has already been prevented.
operational.scaling: None. Always one eligible crossing and a 1-HP floor.
operational.limitations: Does not trigger while the target is already at 0. Does not resurrect, repair a vital body, prevent third death-save failure/fatal Wound death/lethal-track death or override explicitly unpreventable HP loss. Cannot legalize an otherwise unaffordable HP cost. If multiple independently owned wards exist, use only the chosen eligible prevention; unused records retain their own concentration/deadline. This is distinct from Cleric Ritual of Undeath's would-die replacement. Normal spell costs and risk apply.
operational.designNotes: Core Necromancy rank4, 7RP, Action, 60ft and concentration1minute retained with exact class gates. M/F uses the already-reviewed class-focus alternative; no unstated material cost. NEW: living target, explicit positive crossing, outright-death exclusion and competing-prevention procedure. The agreed damage/HP-loss interface is in the candidate guide; reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.

operational.resolution: No attack or save. Check the dead identity's willingness, sufficient body, exact elapsed death window, location and actual resurrection/soul blockers. On a legal successful resolution, return that identity to life at 1 HP.
operational.effect: Change Dead to Living, assign 1 returned HP, clear death-save counters and any previous Stable recovery deadline. Preserve Wounds, Corruption, Oracle Curse, other persistent death consequences and spent resources. This returned HP is a resurrection state transition, not ordinary healing; ordinary healing reductions and generic living HP-gain prohibitions do not change it. Explicit resurrection or soul blockers prevent return.
operational.scaling: None. One identity returns at 1 HP; no additional targets or restored resources.

After successful return, retain Exhaustion6/Expedition6 and enter their protected living-collapse states. Later positive unprevented gain is lethal again; qualifying care and point gates still apply. This candidate remains reviewed for the operational playtest overlay. Known illegal prerequisites prevent activation; a legal cast already paid receives no refund for a later refusal, counter or changed eligibility. Normal RP, Dissonance, Refrain and component rules apply.

actual.name: Soul Bind

operational.targets: One living dying creature at0HP you can perceive within range and line of effect; a Dead or Stable creature is ineligible
operational.duration: Pending tether up to1 minute; if target dies while pending, bound identity for24 elapsed hours from that death
operational.resolution: Target makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On success no effect. On failure create a pending Soul Bind tether with an absolute expiry60 seconds after resolution. Target death before that expiry converts it into one soul-bound identity record with expiry24 hours after the death.
operational.effect: Before death, gaining positiveHP or becoming Stable ends the pending tether. After conversion, that identity cannot return by resurrection until the24-hour record ends or a legally capable source removes it. Neither state requires concentration or ends merely because a caster dies/incapacitates. If death begins at or after the pending absolute expiry, conversion does not occur. Only one Soul Bind family record may exist per identity; another failed-save application while still living/dying refreshes to the later pending endpoint without stacked prisons. No post-death recast is legal because the spell targets a living dying creature.
operational.scaling: None. No increased targets, indefinite duration or automatic save failure.
operational.limitations: Pending dispel/removal targets the creature. After death, existing remains serve as the local magical anchor for an otherwise eligible dispel/removal; if no remains exist, a source must expressly free the bound identity/soul rather than inventing a physical anchor. A generic cure or under-ranked dispel is not sufficient. The spell grants no commands, ownership, memories, personality change or control over the player. Soul-specific temporal restoration uses its own reviewed interface. Normal costs, Dissonance, Refrain and countering apply.
operational.designNotes: Core Necromancy rank9, 26RP, Action, 120ft, V/S/F and dying-target/resurrection-block purpose retained with Cleric/Druid/Wizard17 access. NEW: Charisma save,1-minute pending/24-hour bound states, no concentration, exact expiry collision, source-family refresh and local removal anchor. These replace the otherwise nonoperational Instantaneous summary with explicit finite aftermath. Wider soul cosmology remains open; individually reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.

actual.name: Chain Jolt

operational.targets: Choose one or two distinct creatures or independently legal objects you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect. Each need only be within your range, not near the other target. Declare their resolution order at commitment; the same creature/object cannot receive both jolts.
operational.resolution: After the cast survives its interrupt window, make one ranged spell attack independently against each still-legal chosen target in declared order. Each hit deals an independently rolled 1d8 lightning; each miss deals nothing. Each attack has its ordinary attack-reaction opportunities and its own attack/damage event.
operational.effect: One cast supplies at most these two attacks. A lost or invalidated target receives no substituted jolt and provides no retargeting. One attack’s outcome does not change the other’s die or convert the spell into a freely bouncing chain.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No automatic Stunned, Reaction denial, unselected secondary creature, extra reach or free ongoing link. Objects must be independently legal targets with actual object AC, durability and material/damage defenses. This spell grants no generic permission to target an unwilling creature’s worn/carried equipment, no invented object statistics and no automatic secondary equipment damage. Actual class/source access, repertoire, level, action availability, components, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter/outcome hooks follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. These actual rank-1 placements have base 2 RP; real source modifiers and strain surcharges still apply. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable free hand or an actual exception, and F is the ordinary class focus. A legal cast commits payment and cast-begin consequences before its Counterspell window; later failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual casting modifier against AC; natural 1 misses/natural 20 hits and doubles only actual attack damage dice. Saves use DC 8 + PB + actual casting modifier and binary-save rules. Actual target/area defenses and source-specific hooks retain their real trigger scopes. No automatic level scaling, generic upcast, new action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, V/S/F and two targets for1d8 lightning each. NEW: up-to-two flexibility, independent ranged spell attacks/dice, creature/legal-object selection, and explicit fixed target order. No double allocation to one target or imported bounce-distance restriction.

Outside initiative: application +6 seconds. Preserve the original corresponding regular/virtual marker or absolute deadline across entry/exit/reorder, absence, plane change and extra turns.
operational.resolution: Make a ranged spell attack. Miss: no damage or delayed rider. Hit: resolve 4d4 acid, doubling only those initial attack dice on a critical. After that packet, if the same recipient remains the same continuing eligible creature/object, attach the delayed rider unless an actual defense prevents it. Initial damage reduced to 0 does not itself prevent attachment. Merely reaching 0 HP is not automatically death or loss of continuing creature identity. If the initial packet actually kills/ends that creature identity or destroys that object before attachment, no rider is created.
operational.effect: At its scheduled marker, an existing unsuppressed rider deals a separately rolled 2d4 acid to the same continuing recipient as one nonattack packet, then ends. This is an existing-effect consequence, not a cast: no RP, Dissonance, Refrain, cast-begin hook or Counterspell window; ordinary damage/outcome hooks keep their actual predicates. No delayed critical dice. Every qualifying hit has an independent source-owned rider, including same-ID casts by the same or different owners; they coexist rather than refresh or replace. Simultaneous due riders resolve in stable application order as separate packets. An eligible dispel/removal can end a specific pending rank-2 rider before execution despite the source’s Instantaneous cast metadata. Suppression never pauses its marker. If suppressed when due, consume the one-shot event without damage, end that rider, and never replay it after suppression lifts. Movement, lost range/line of effect/perception, caster absence and identity-preserving transformation do not alone end the rider. Actual death/ended continuing creature identity, object destruction or replacement/resummoning ends its recipient’s rider; resurrection/recreation does not inherit it. Actual transformation/source rules may independently end or suppress it.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, targets, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No delayed retargeting to a corpse, replacement or last location; no extra-turn acceleration or timing reset; no washing/scraping removal procedure, physical recoverable arrow or mundane acid material. actual.name: Summon Spectral Steed

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you perceive within range and line of effect large enough to contain the mount.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier at concentration end or steed0 HP.
operational.resolution: No creation roll. A commanded Planar Crossing uses the steed's Action and its one crossing attempt. Spend that use when the attempt starts. It teleports the steed, any eligible mounted rider and permitted gear together to a specific known site on another plane, or fails safely at origin if arrival is illegal or an exact ward blocks it. Failure does not refund the attempt or actions and reveals no reason or hidden coordinates.
operational.effect:
Create a Large noncombat spectral mount: AC 14, HP 30, walking Speed60, body mass 500 pounds, saves equal to owner PB, other checks+0, ordinary sight/hearing; it understands the owner's spoken commands without speech or telepathy. It acts immediately after the owner. An owner Bonus Action command within 60 feet and perceptible to it permits movement plus Dodge, Dash or Planar Crossing; Dash uses the ordinary movement-budget rules. It shares the owner-wide companion command allowance but supplies no damaging Action. Uncommanded it may move defensively and Dodge. It may carry one willing Medium-or-smaller rider plus that rider's legally carried noncreature gear, within 350 pounds AND 12 Load total. Count the rider's effective body weight plus every item once; count body casualty Load (Tiny 1.5/Small 3/Medium 6) plus all gear Load, including melded gear. At 6–12 Load it is Burdened under BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md: Speed reduced10 feet and relevant check disadvantage. These fixed capacities do not imply a Strength score. Mounting requires an Action while adjacent to the stationary steed and within both capacities. Dismounting voluntarily requires an Action while it is stationary, to a legal adjacent space; this Action includes that placement. While riding, select one 5-foot portion of the steed's footprint as the rider's position; it moves with that portion, without free repositioning among its squares. Other positioning requires actual legal movement/actions. If the steed disappears or the rider can no longer legally ride, the rider remains at their current rider position and ordinary support/Falling applies; use the body guide's minimum adjacent placement rule if a persistent steed/obstruction makes that position illegal, never teleport through a barrier. An imposed excess load or anatomy change cannot be vetoed to preserve riding.

For Planar Crossing, the owner chooses one specific arrival site on a different plane that they personally visited or can uniquely identify from a reliable map, description or established source. The command authorizes the attempt; the steed spends its Action after the owner. A mounted rider must still willingly accept and fit the capacity/anatomy rules. An unladen steed may also cross. Arrival needs legal space for the whole mount and rider; ordinary support requirements apply, so unsupported arrival leads to Falling rather than hover. Distance to the destination is not limited by the 60-foot summoning/command range. The spell provides the interplanar transition itself without requiring an existing portal, but no same-plane teleport. The group moves atomically, preserving relative rider position, belongings, conditions and ongoing clocks. Nothing is left in a between-planes buffer. No portal remains for followers.
operational.scaling: Only its expressly printed owner-PB saves change. Fixed AC 14/HP 30/Speed60 before ordinary burden/conditions,350 lb/12 Load capacity and one crossing do not automatically scale.
operational.limitations: One Spectral Steed per caster; one crossing attempt per steed. Resummoning requires a new legal paid cast and new mounting/commands, never a free refresh. This profile grants no attack, autonomous opportunity attack, Help advantage, flight, hover, phase movement, special senses, resistance/immunity, spellcasting, sale value, loot, corpse or resource trigger. It cannot carry a second creature or independent casualty inside a bag, nor substitute cargo-only hauling for the printed rider-and-gear role. No additional carrying capacity, gear ownership change or magical location search is supplied. Its known destination need not be visible or in originating line of effect; the explicit interplanar exception is still subject to actual arrival legality and written blockers. The command must be valid at attempt start; crossing itself does not cancel that already committed command because distance/plane then changes. Future commands require their own actual range/perception. Concentration is not given an extra plane/range tether; clocks continue. Dismissal does not return or delete riders/property. Travel may avoid a geographic route segment but does not settle claims, contamination, law, Opening time or Extraction by declaration. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F/concentration 1 minute and a mount that truly travels between planes. NEW: complete finite mount/riding/command/crossing profile and one attempt, known-site eligibility and atomic custody. REVIEWED CORRECTION: source conference proposed6 Load, but reviewed BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md assigns a Medium transported body 6 Load before equipment. Use 12 Load total with unchanged350 lb ceiling, counting the body and applying ordinary Burdened at 6 Load. This explicitly changes the NEW proposal to support the promised rider plus gear; it is not a source-derived number. All fixed profile values require human balance review.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, travel-system implementation, numerical balance and whole-game validation pending

actual.name: Remove Curse

operational.targets: One creature or object you can perceive within range and line of effect. No willingness or prior curse-detection requirement.
operational.resolution: Pay and cast against the legal creature/object target before resolving its hidden afflictions. No saving throw. Select a known distinguishable curse; if eligible curse identities are hidden and more than one actual removable curse exists, the Director selects one without revealing unrelated metadata. If none is eligible, no curse ends and no paid cost is refunded; the spell grants no separate diagnostic report.
operational.effect: End one actual inflicted affliction record classified as a curse that affects the selected target, invoking that curse's own ending procedure. No general spell-rank ceiling applies: this is curse removal rather than dispelling.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Explicit non-removability, required special cures, protected information and source-specific restrictions override this generic removal. A name containing curse is not an affliction classification. Oracle intrinsic Curse, Burden, Boons and Manifestation cannot be removed or suspended. Ending a curse does not undo historical HP damage, alignment/reputation changes, resource payments, Wounds, death or other consequences unless that curse's actual ending rule explicitly does so. Ordinary observations of a real change remain possible. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

actual.name: Alignment Weapon

operational.targets: One willing creature's free hand, including your own, or an unoccupied space you perceive within range.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends or the weapon reaches 0 HP.
operational.resolution: Automatic creation; casting grants no attack. Later attacks use the wielder's ordinary Strength weapon attack and Strength damage modifier, adding PB only with actual simple-melee proficiency. Resolve normal hits, misses, criticals and defenses.
operational.effect: Conjure a spectral one-handed simple melee weapon: choose and fix bludgeoning, piercing or slashing; base 1d6 plus wielder Strength modifier; reach 5 feet; weight 3 pounds; AC15/HP5. It has no unstated Light, Finesse, Thrown, Versatile, Reach or other weapon property. Its attacks count as magical weapon attacks with the chosen physical type. On each successful hit compare the current wielder's actual current canonical alignment to that target's actual current alignment. At least one recorded exact opposite axis (Lawful/Chaotic or Good/Evil) adds 1d6 of the chosen physical damage type to that hit. Neutral is not opposite. Unrecorded/unknown axes supply no opposition; one recorded opposite axis suffices when the other is unknown. Records may be known to the Director without being known to the wielder. A normal critical doubles the base 1d6 and any qualifying alignment 1d6, while Strength remains flat.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: The bonus applies per qualifying hit, with no invented once-turn cap. Ordinary Attack Actions, actual Extra Attack, opportunity attacks and weapon riders apply only when their own requirements accept this weapon. A change of wielder changes later alignment comparisons but refreshes no resource. No alignment announcement, personality/belief change, oath ruling, forced allegiance or magical secret report is produced; observers may make ordinary deductions from damage/events. One weapon per caster; ordinary handing, dropping, disarming, anatomy and custody apply. At 0 HP or concentration end it disappears. It is not autonomous, saleable, crafting material, ammunition or permanent inventory. For this card, if generic suppression suppresses spell effects without removing conjured objects, the weapon remains usable at its base physical 1d6 profile but loses magical-weapon qualification and alignment bonus until suppression ends; duration/concentration obligations continue. A source explicitly dismissing conjured objects overrides that default. Suppression ending restores only properties of the still-existing unexpired weapon, not lost HP, duration, spent actions or previous-hit riders. These are native HP objects; no Integrity track or HP/Integrity conversion is supplied. Damage/effects must actually be able to affect the relevant object; having HP grants no creature eligibility. No unstated resistance, immunity or organic-target eligibility is supplied. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F, created weapon and +1d6 against opposing alignment. NEW: reviewed Minor Weapon base physical profile, finite 1-minute concentration instead of Instantaneous metadata, current-wielder/current-target two-axis comparison, exact per-hit rider/critical handling and suppression default confined to this card. A missing axis is never guessed from species, faction, appearance or player beliefs.
